data.content_ref: inline:The convergence of all derivations on 648 depends on a shared mechanism: the correct handling of the zero-digit asymmetry, where zero is excluded from the hundreds place but permitted elsewhere. This shared mechanism is refuted if any derivation yields 648 while incorrectly allowing zero in the hundreds place, as the count would then exceed 648 by 72, proving the derivations do not share a common combinatorial constraint.
